newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Angping says DMCI a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Angping says DMCI a buy.

text.p: Angping Securities on Wednesday recommended a buy on construction firm DMCI Holdings Inc after the firm signed a water supply joint venture project with Biwater International Ltd of United Kingdom.

"The company has long been wanting to pursue and actually be part of a project that would generate a healthy, continuous and profitable flow of revenues for the long term ... This step should provide a strong support for long term earnings growth," analyst Warren Chua said in a report.
He said that other construction projects should start contributing to DMCI's bottomline by next year.
Chua estimated the stock was trading at only 13 times earnings on the back of a 57 percent growth in profit.
The stock was trading at 19.00 pesos by midsession, unchanged from Tuesday's close.
